```{r}
#| label: prep-data
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

### Annual updating steps:
LAST_YEAR  <- 2025   # school year ending in spring of this year
FIRST_YEAR <- 2021
###

###### read csv data (district personnel + district financial/enrollment)
h1 <- "https://raw."
h2 <- "git"
h3 <- "hub"
h4 <- "user"
h5 <- "content"
h6 <- ".com/"
base_url <- paste0(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)

repo <- "Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/"
folder <- "SPENDING%2CENROLLMENT/"
f1 <- "personnel-master-thru2025.csv"
f2 <- "slfs_essa_financial_merged_thru2025.csv"

personnel_url <- paste0(base_url, repo, folder, f1)
financial_url <- paste0(base_url, repo, folder, f2)

# fuction to keep 12-digit BEDS code as text (keeps leading zero, avoids scientific notation in JSON)
pad_cd <- function(x) sprintf("%012.0f", as.numeric(x))

# Personnel: one row per district x year x staff type
df1 <- read_csv(personnel_url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(is.na(NEEDS_RESOURCE_DESC) | NEEDS_RESOURCE_DESC != "CHARTER SCHOOL") 

# Enrollment: one row per district x year
df2 <- read_csv(financial_url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    ENTITY_CD = pad_cd(ENTITY_CD),
    YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR),
    PK12_Enrollment = as.numeric(PK12_Enrollment)
  ) %>%
  distinct(ENTITY_CD, YEAR, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Keep all personnel rows, add enrollment where there's a match
raw <- df1 %>%
  left_join(df2, by = c("ENTITY_CD", "YEAR")) %>%
  filter(YEAR >= FIRST_YEAR, YEAR <= LAST_YEAR)

# PK12_Enrollment is stored as text; strip any commas/suppression marks
raw <- raw |>
  mutate(PK12_Enrollment = parse_number(as.character(PK12_Enrollment)))

lab_students <- "Students"
lab_teachers <- "Classroom Teachers"
lab_other    <- "Aministrators, Priciples, Other non-Inst.Staff"

# Enrollment is repeated on every staff row, so take one value per district-year
students <- raw |>
  distinct(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, PK12_Enrollment) |>
  transmute(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series = lab_students, value = PK12_Enrollment)

# Two staff groups: classroom teachers vs. every other role combined
staff <- raw |>
  mutate(series = if_else(STAFF_IND_DESC == "Classroom Teacher",
                          lab_teachers, lab_other)) |>
  group_by(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series) |>
  summarise(value = sum(TOTAL_FTE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Change since FIRST_YEAR. Rounded and trimmed to keep the page size down.
long <- bind_rows(students, staff) |>
  group_by(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, series) |>
  mutate(
    baseline = value[YEAR == FIRST_YEAR][1],   # NA if district has no first-year value
    change   = value - baseline
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(change)) |>
  mutate(value = round(value, 2), change = round(change, 2)) |>
  select(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series, value, change) |>
  arrange(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, series, YEAR)

# Calculate staff average salaries using AVG_SAL_FOR_FTE
calc_salary <- function(sal, fte) {
  sal <- as.numeric(sal)
  fte <- as.numeric(fte)
  valid <- !is.na(sal) & sal > 0
  if (!any(valid)) return(NA_real_)
  sal <- sal[valid]
  fte <- fte[valid]
  fte[is.na(fte) | fte <= 0] <- 1
  sum(sal * fte) / sum(fte)
}

salaries <- raw %>%
  mutate(AVG_SAL_FOR_FTE = parse_number(as.character(AVG_SAL_FOR_FTE))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AVG_SAL_FOR_FTE), AVG_SAL_FOR_FTE > 0, !is.na(STAFF_IND_DESC)) %>%
  mutate(series = if_else(STAFF_IND_DESC == "Classroom Teacher", lab_teachers, as.character(STAFF_IND_DESC))) %>%
  group_by(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series) %>%
  summarise(
    salary = round(calc_salary(AVG_SAL_FOR_FTE, TOTAL_FTE), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(salary)) %>%
  # Change in average salary since FIRST_YEAR (same approach as the first plot)
  group_by(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, series) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline = salary[YEAR == FIRST_YEAR][1],   # NA if no first-year salary for this role
    change   = salary - baseline
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(change)) %>%
  select(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series, salary, change) %>%
  arrange(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, series, YEAR)

# Hand the data to Observable JS
ojs_define(chg = long,
           salaries = salaries,
           first_year = FIRST_YEAR, last_year = LAST_YEAR)
```

```{ojs}
lastYear  = [].concat(last_year)[0]
yearTicks = Array.from({length: lastYear - firstYear + 1}, (_, i) => firstYear + i)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// guard function
// makes a submit and reset button to use after multiple inputs made

function guard(fn, options = {}, countyView) {
  const {
    submitLabel = "Submit",
    resetLabel = "Reset",
    required = false,
    resubmit = true,
    width = "100%",
    justify = "start"
  } = options;

  const onSubmit = () => {
    value = input.value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
    wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };

  const onReset = () => {
    input.value = value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
  };

  const onInnerInputCapture = () => {
    invalid = true;
    submit.disabled = true;
  };

  const onInnerInput = e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    submit.disabled = false;
    reset.disabled = false;
  };

  const submit = htl.html`
    <button ${{disabled: !resubmit && !required, onclick: onSubmit}}>
      ${submitLabel}
  `;

  const reset = htl.html`
    <button ${{disabled: true, onclick: onReset}}>
      ${resetLabel}
  `;

  const footer = htl.html`
    <div>
      <hr style="padding:0;margin:10px 0">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:1ch;justify-content:${justify}">
        ${submit}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

const template = inputs => {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "input-toolbar";

  row.append(countyView);

  (Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : Object.values(inputs))
    .forEach(input => row.append(input));

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText =
    "width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box";

  container.append(row, footer);

  return container;
};

  const input = fn({
    submit,
    reset,
    footer,
    template,
    onSubmit,
    onReset
  });

  let invalid = !!input.querySelector(":invalid");
  submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;

  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInputCapture, {capture: true});
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInput);

  let value = required ? undefined : input.value;

  const wrapper = htl.html`<div style="width:${width}">${input}`;

  wrapper.addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);

  return Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {
    get: () => value,
    set: v => { input.value = v }
  });
}

// view: "Annual" = average salary each year; "Change Over Time" = change since firstYear
function salaryPlot(data, width, height, view = "Annual") {

  const annual = view === "Annual";
  const yField = annual ? "salary" : "change";
  const money  = n => n != null ? `$${n.toLocaleString()}` : "";
  const signed = n => `${n < 0 ? "-" : "+"}$${Math.abs(n).toLocaleString()}`;

  // Colors/order come from roleColors (defined once, below, and shared with the
  // salary table so the two always match)
  const domain = salaryDomain(data);
  const range = domain.map(s => roleColors.get(s) ?? fallbackColor);

  return Plot.plot({
    className: "StaffSalary-plot",

    width,
    height,
    marginLeft: 80,
    marginBottom: 50,
    marginRight: 30,

    x: { label: "School year (ending)", tickFormat: "d", ticks: yearTicks, labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: false },
    y: {
      label: annual ? "Average Salary ($)" : `Change in average salary since ${firstYear} ($)`,
      grid: true, labelAnchor: "center", tickFormat: "$,d", ticks: 7, labelArrow: false
    },
    // no legend here: the table above the plot is the legend
    color: {
      domain: domain,
      range: range
    },
    marks: [
      ...(annual ? [] : [Plot.ruleY([0])]),
      Plot.line(data, {x: "YEAR", y: yField, stroke: "series", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(data, {x: "YEAR", y: yField, stroke: "series", r: 4}),
      Plot.tip(data, Plot.pointer({
        x: "YEAR", y: yField, stroke: "series",
        title: d => annual
          ? `${d.series}\nAverage Salary: ${money(d.salary)}\nChange since ${firstYear}: ${signed(d.change)}`
          : `${d.series}\nChange: ${signed(d.change)}\nAverage Salary: ${money(d.salary)}`
      }))
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// One fixed color per role (not assigned by order of appearance), so a role
// keeps the same color in every district. No blues anywhere.
// Orange = classroom teachers and red = administrators, as in the first plot.
// The map order is also the order of the rows in the salary table.
roleColors = new Map([
  ["Classroom Teachers",            "#E08A1E"],  // orange (same as plot 1)
  ["Classroom Teacher",             "#E08A1E"],  // (alias, only used if the R label changes)
  ["Central Administration",        "#D95C5C"],  // red (same as plot 1)
  ["Program Administration",        "#1c9b84"],  // teal
  ["Principals & Asst. Principals", "#874197"],  // purple (dark)
  ["Other Non-Teaching Staff",      "#444444"],  // charcoal gray
  ["Guidance Counselors",           "#d76cb7"],  // pink (light)
  ["Psychologists & Psychiatrists", "#0c6944"],  // forest green
  ["Social Workers",                "#9c3a11"],  // rust brown
  ["Nurses",                        "#827f11"]   // olive
]);

fallbackColor = "#8c8c8c";  // any role not listed above

// Roles present in the data, in the fixed order above (an unlisted role goes last)
function salaryDomain(data) {
  const present = new Set(data.map(d => d.series));
  return [
    ...[...roleColors.keys()].filter(s => present.has(s)),
    ...[...present].filter(s => !roleColors.has(s))
  ];
}

// Table that replaces the plot legend: color, staff type, average salary
// (average salary is for the most recent year, lastYear)
function salaryTable(data) {
  if (!data || !data.length) return htl.html``;

  const roles = salaryDomain(data);
  const latest = new Map(
    data.filter(d => Number(d.YEAR) === Number(lastYear)).map(d => [d.series, d.salary])
  );
  const money = n => n != null ? `$${n.toLocaleString()}` : "–";
  const cell = "padding:3px 16px 3px 0;border:0;";

  return htl.html`<table style="width:auto;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:0.85rem;margin:0 0 6px 0">
    <thead>
      <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;text-align:left">
        <th style="${cell}">Color</th>
        <th style="${cell}">Staff type</th>
        <th style="${cell}text-align:right">Average salary, ${lastYear}</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      ${roles.map(r => htl.html`<tr>
        <td style="${cell}"><span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;vertical-align:middle;background:${roleColors.get(r) ?? fallbackColor}"></span></td>
        <td style="${cell}">${r}</td>
        <td style="${cell}text-align:right">${money(latest.get(r))}</td>
      </tr>`)}
    </tbody>
  </table>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// view: "Change Over Time" = change since firstYear; "Annual" = the actual value each year
function changePlot(data, width, height, view = "Change Over Time") {

  const annual = view === "Annual";
  const yField = annual ? "value" : "change";

  return Plot.plot({
    className: "StudentStaffgrowth-plot",

    width,
    height,
    marginLeft: 80,
    marginBottom: 50,
    marginRight: 30,

    x: { label: "School year (ending)", tickFormat: "d", ticks: yearTicks, labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: false },
    y: {
      label: annual ? "Students (head count) and staff (FTE)" : `Change since ${firstYear}`,
      grid: true, labelAnchor: "center", ticks: 7, labelArrow: false
    },
    color: {
      domain: [
        "Students",
        "Classroom Teachers",
        "Aministrators, Priciples, Other non-Inst.Staff"
      ],
      range: ["#4f81a8", "#E08A1E", "#d95c5c"],
      legend: true
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.line(data, {x: "YEAR", y: yField, stroke: "series", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(data, {x: "YEAR", y: yField, stroke: "series", r: 4}),
      Plot.tip(data, Plot.pointer({
        x: "YEAR", y: yField, stroke: "series",
        title: d => annual
          ? `${d.series}\nTotal: ${d.value.toFixed(1)}\nChange since ${firstYear}: ${d.change >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.change.toFixed(1)}`
          : `${d.series}\nChange: ${d.change.toFixed(1)}\nTotal: ${d.value.toFixed(1)}`
      }))
    ]
  });
}
```

## Sourcedata, Notes {#print-footer}
* Data Source - Staff data: PMF Statistical Run
* Data Source - Student enrollment data: ESSA Financial Reporting
* "Aministrators, Priciples, Other Staff" is the sum of non-classroom-teacher staff.
* A district is omitted when that year's value is unavailable.
* Salary change is each role's average salary (weighted by FTE) minus its average salary in the first year shown; a role with no first-year salary is omitted from the salary plot.
* Charter schools and NYC districts are not included.
